purpose: Prevent Character Design Sheet 01-04 generation from bypassing the single production character prompt exporter and every later readiness/review/fidelity authority added on main after this inventory branch diverged.

existingInventoryPacket.reason: Its authority snapshots predate the mandatory single production exporter and later fidelity authorities now present on main.

latestMainRequirementsToIntegrate.requirement: Character image readiness must be READY_FOR_CANDIDATE_GENERATION with zero readiness failures; OPEN is never model freedom.
Only ACTIVE reviewed recurrence directives may affect later generation; candidate rejection does not automatically become global design law.
The single production-ready character exporter is tools/asset-factory/scripts/export-production-character-design-prompt.ts; handwritten/lower exporter outputs are not production-ready.
All 36 characters must use the full color-production boundary; Current21 exact HEX and Future15 unresolved exact palette must not be invented.
Character identity must remain stable across reference, sprite, cut-in, Dawn/Kokuyou and emblem-adjacent asset kinds under a simplification hierarchy.

Cross-asset fidelity review is fail-closed: identity-critical species/age/body, face, mass/proportion/mobility equipment, head/hair, silhouette/posture and clothing/exposure axes cannot be rescued by a high weighted score.
Candidate fidelity review packets/evaluation produce system recommendations only; automation may not impersonate reviewer verdict or create authority/recurrence directives.
Expression, cut-in intensity and state changes must preserve base face geometry and age coding; Dawn/Kokuyou may not rebuild the face.
Perspective/foreshortening/motion may not redesign body mass, limb thickness, head/body proportions, clothing anchors, exposure, prop scale or mobility equipment.
Hands/paws/manipulators, props, storage and mobility equipment require physically coherent contact/load paths; unknown dominant hand stays OPEN_DO_NOT_INVENT.

Weather/environment effects must act causally on authorized materials/body/props without inventing wardrobe, exposure or magical decoration; unknown environment defaults to neutral physically plausible minimal effect.

requiredPostSyncArchitecture.sheetAdapterPurpose: Start from the latest production-ready resolved character prompt/authority chain, then add only Sheet-role-specific composition and QA constraints without replacing or weakening upstream identity/color/garment/light/world/acting/feedback/readiness/expression/motion/contact/environment guards.

yuiSheet01AdditionalHardConstraints: four same-scale full-body views: front, anatomical-left, anatomical-right, back
one canonical anatomical coordinate system; do not substitute viewer-left/right for body-left/right
lantern remains anatomical RIGHT hand when carried
paper remains anatomical LEFT hand when carried
strap remains anatomical RIGHT shoulder to anatomical LEFT waist
dominant hand remains OPEN_NO_SOURCE and may not be inferred from held-item hand
same face/body/clothing/equipment topology across all four views
Yui bilateral smile dimples remain an identity requirement rather than optional decoration
